asked.item: Pinterest error 'Sorry! This site doesn't allow you to save Pins'
How to get around it (own blog link)

verdict.reason: The Troubleshooting page covers this exact Pinterest error, its causes, and the query parameter workaround.

steps.text: This error comes from Pinterest, not Blotato, and it means Pinterest blocked the destination link in your pin.
Two common causes are that the destination website opted out of being pinned, or that Pinterest's blocklist flagged your URL, often a false positive.
To work around it, add a query parameter to the end of your link, for example ?ref=pin or ?v=111, so Pinterest reads it as a new URL.
Use the modified link in your pin and publish again.
